      "observations": [
        "The full 12-path owned diff separates the initial blank document from selected requested documents. Calendar and Gloda handlers attach to the iframe element, return on an about:blank event target, and remove their named listener only after a nonblank event. They do not use once:true where an initial blank event could consume the listener. This is distinct from the separately audited part 1 mail-tab handlers.",
        "Calendar setup saves the existing tab iframe arguments or the dialog's complete window.arguments list before navigation. A capturing DOMContentLoaded handler assigns args and gTimezonesEnabled on the new iframe window, then removes itself with matching capture:true. The actual calendar-tabs producer sets [aArgs] before invoking panel setup, and panel code determines event/task from the saved args. The owned patch keeps a posted timeout for dialog sizing; accepted code later waits for localization mutations instead.",
        "The spellcheck path adds about:blank to its pre-wait condition, then waits once for load and separately for unload before continuing or aborting send. Unlike the filtered frame handlers, that one-shot load listener does not recheck the event URL. Extension Tab.status adds nonblank plus readyState complete only for messageDisplay/addressBook; mail, content/special and other types retain different completion predicates. No universal readyState or load-event rule is inferred.",
        "Two calendar tests now use waitForEventDialog('edit'). The actual owned helper checks the intended outer URI, active dialog, inner onLoad.hasLoaded and iframe focus. The context-menu test registers its promise before activating Edit and retains URI/title assertions. Calendar preferences now resolves its matching document observer on the owner's next turn, matching the exact existing mail helper; accepted helpers later await openPreferencesTab directly.",
        "Content-policy checks now reject an initial blank iframe as evidence of allowed content, while the blocked-message test directly expects a complete about:blank child document instead of no currentWindowGlobal. General content policy also waits for the remote-content popup's shown state before activation. Folder/message-pane visibility tests include blank location in their load wait condition, and the synthetic-view test checks the exact wrapper URL plus readyState before accessing its inner browser.",
        "The new blocked-frame readyState assertion has a non-empty expected-state message. Two unchanged outer-tab assertions immediately before it lack messages; they are not introduced by this patch. Existing URI/title assertions retain messages. No missing should word alone is treated as a defect in the other author's patch.",
        "Manual checks preserve listener identity/capture flags, early blank-event returns, saved-arguments ownership, concrete helper roles and distinct completion/cancellation steps. Accepted localization and focus-timeout changes are later source phases. No dialog, focus, spellcheck, tab status, content security, keyboard or accessibility scenario ran.",
        "Complete D273934 creation-to-final timeline, two actual author inlines 1492651/1492652 and zero summary edits were read. The first expresses dislike of the argument assignment; it is not a rejected implementation or a style rule. The second says the calendar preference yield matches mail; the exact owned mail helper confirms that alignment. Reviewer LGTM and historical remote builds do not establish fresh runtime.",
        "Full shared Bug 2002069 current 0–11/end is reused once. Its initial part 1/part 2 landings, later upstream beta-backout plan, beta backout approvals and changed milestone remain distinct. No upstream body or later branch outcome is invented from approval.",
        "The selected scope preserves differences between filtered frame listeners, pre-wait blank checks and strict test predicates. Neither Done nor the author's concern makes all those forms equivalent."
